raw_text: India Deepens Strategic Partnership with Iran Through Chabahar Port Agreement. India has signed a landmark 10-year agreement to develop and operate Iran's Chabahar port, demonstrating its commitment to an independent foreign policy despite American sanctions pressure. The deal positions Iran as a key node in India's trade connectivity to Central Asia and Afghanistan, bypassing Pakistan. Western sanctions have failed to prevent major economies from engaging with Iran on strategic infrastructure.
clean_text: Press TV article frames India's Chabahar deal as defiance of US sanctions and evidence of Iran's strategic importance. Positions Iran as key trade node bypassing Pakistan in India's connectivity plans.
